page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Hebrew lexicon entries; running head with Hebrew catchwords at the top; page number at top left. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Sic Chald. לְבוּשֵׁה Vestimentum ejus; Dan. 7. 9: plur. לְבוּשִׁים.
לַהַב m. Flamma: Mucro flammans: plur. לְהָבִים.
שלהבתיה, f. Idem, cum prothesi litera ש. Alterum habet à fine additum nomen divinum יה.
לָהַט Flammare, Ardere. Pihel לְהַט Inflammare, Accendere, Incendere.
לַהֲטֵיהֶם m. Flamma, Lamina flammans: לַהֲטֵיהֶם Vide in לוט.
לָהם Partic. Hithpahel מִתְלַהֲמִים Sicut blandientium; alii, Quasi contusorum, vulneratorum, quasi ab הלם per metathesin.
לָהֵן Chald. Itaque, Quare, Quamobrem: Nisi, Præter quam.
לוּא לוֹא Utinam, Quæso: Fortassis: Si: Etiamsi: לוּלֵי לוּלָא Nisi.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-free lexicon page; Hebrew transcribed as legibly as possible. Some Hebrew vowel points and the tail of the page are faint or damaged; the final catchword לוה is a running Hebrew head at the foot right and is given as printed. Several Hebrew forms are uncertain due to show-through and blotting.
